description: This file defines the interface for buffer management within rbus, including data structures, function prototypes for encoding, decoding, reading, writing, and manipulating rbusBuffer objects used for binary data operations.

classes.name: rbusBuffer
classes.description: A data structure representing a buffer with allocated length, read/write positions, and internal data storage, with a fixed size array for small data optimization.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Create
methods.description: Initializes a new rbusBuffer instance, allocating necessary resources.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Destroy
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the rbusBuffer instance.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Reserve
methods.description: Reserves additional space in the buffer to accommodate upcoming data.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Write
methods.description: Writes raw data into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteTypeLengthValue
methods.description: Writes a TLV-encoded value into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteBooleanTLV
methods.description: Writes a boolean value as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteCharTLV
methods.description: Writes a character as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteByteTLV
methods.description: Writes a byte as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteInt8TLV
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit integer as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteUInt8TLV
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 8-bit integer as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteInt16TLV
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit integer as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteUInt16TLV
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 16-bit integer as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteInt32TLV
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit integer as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteUInt32TLV
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 32-bit integer as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteInt64TLV
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit integer as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteUInt64TLV
methods.description: Writes an unsigned 64-bit integer as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteSingleTLV
methods.description: Writes a float as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteDoubleTLV
methods.description: Writes a double as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteStringTLV
methods.description: Writes a string with specified length as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteDateTimeTLV
methods.description: Writes a datetime value as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_WriteBytesTLV
methods.description: Writes a byte array as TLV into the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_Read
methods.description: Reads raw data from the buffer into supplied memory.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadBoolean
methods.description: Reads a boolean value from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadChar
methods.description: Reads a character from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadByte
methods.description: Reads a byte from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadInt8
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadUInt8
methods.description: Reads an unsigned 8-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadInt16
methods.description: Reads a 16-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadUInt16
methods.description: Reads an unsigned 16-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadInt32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadUInt32
methods.description: Reads an unsigned 32-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadInt64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadUInt64
methods.description: Reads an unsigned 64-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadSingle
methods.description: Reads a float from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadDouble
methods.description: Reads a double from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadString
methods.description: Reads a string from the buffer; caller must free the string.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadDateTime
methods.description: Reads a datetime value from the buffer.

methods.name: rbusBuffer_ReadBytes
methods.description: Reads a byte array from the buffer; caller must free the byte array.
